preview.tournamentOverview: The World Wide Technology Championship is played at El Cardonal at Diamante, a course that places a premium on ball-striking and approach play. The layout rewards players who can hit fairways and control iron shots into firm, small greens, while putting remains a secondary factor.
preview.modelExplainer: Our model assigns 30% weight to SG Total, 20% to SG Approach, and 15% each to SG Off-the-Tee and SG Putting. Driving Accuracy and Bogey Avoidance receive smaller weights of 3% and 4%, reflecting the course's emphasis on precision over raw distance. The 10% weight on SG Around-the-Green accounts for the need to scramble effectively on tight lies around the greens.
preview.pickApproach: Top-tier bets target golfers inside the top 10 model ranks who also rank inside the top 40 in power rank.
